description: Registry of Soft Body simulations and experiments.

cloth_simulation.name: Cloth Simulation
cloth_simulation.description: Soft body physics simulation using spring-mass systems

flagdancer.name: Flag Dancer
flagdancer.description: Animated soft body flag that waves and dances using cloth physics simulation with wind forces.

softbody3d.name: SoftBody 3D
softbody3d.description: Core soft body physics demonstration using Godot's SoftBody3D node for deformable mesh simulation.
softbody3d.qfep_connection: The body reads its own name to learn what it is ('sphere' in node_name decides its pressure and precision), then cycles IDLE, ACTIVE, DEFORMED, RECOVERING on a three-second timer. Identity assigned by label, softness performed on a schedule — deformation not as event but as shift rotation.

squishy_ball_pit.name: Squishy Ball Pit
squishy_ball_pit.description: A glass container filled with squishy, glowing soft body spheres.
squishy_ball_pit.qfep_connection: Thirty pressurized spheres dripped one per half-second into a glass box: the squish only reads because the walls refuse to give. E_flux needs an F_order container to pile up against — without the rigid glass the softness would disperse into nothing worth watching.

soft_trampoline.name: Soft Trampoline
soft_trampoline.description: A large, bouncy soft body sheet pinned at the edges.
soft_trampoline.qfep_connection: The center can flex only because the perimeter is pinned to nothing — set_point_pinned with an empty NodePath fixes the edge vertices to world space itself. Bounce is a liberty financed by an absolute, invisible border.

breathing_room.name: Breathing Room
breathing_room.description: A corridor with soft body walls that rhythmically expand and contract.

dna.default: substance=solid, aperture=ajar - both are strict no-ops. `solid` returns from _apply_substance() before a StandardMaterial3D is constructed, so material_override stays unassigned and the slabs keep Godot's default grey; `ajar` returns from _apply_aperture() before either transform is read, so the authored x = -2.3185759 and x = +3.5541987 are untouched. All twelve appearances render exactly as before: the 5 grid tokens (SoftBodies_Obsticals, _p1, _p2, _p3, Corridor_SoftBodies_Obsticals), the 6 exhibit_furniture#mount:breathing_room slots in Trial_castelvecchio / grande / kanazawa / sainsbury / uffizi / wfc_softbodies, and the Curation_Bay_softbodies_0 roster. None carries a #substance: or #aperture: token, and a bare token leaves merged_config empty so apply_grid_config is never called at all.
dna.was: the .tscn root carried NO SCRIPT - two hand-authored SoftBody3D slabs with baked pinned points, no material override, and no breathing. The sinusoidal pressure loop the description promises lives in the sibling breathing_room.gd, which nothing in the repository loads.
dna.declined: breath_speed and breath_amplitude, the orphan script's named critical_parameter. They modulate pressure_coefficient over time, the evidence here is one still per value, and soft bodies are still settling at the 1.1 s capture settle - sweeping them would photograph the settle, not the axis.
dna.note: aperture is applied in _enter_tree, before the SoftBody3D children enter the tree and pin their empty-path attachments to world space. A value arriving later through apply_grid_config can still change substance but cannot move a live soft body.

soft_mushrooms.name: Soft Mushrooms
soft_mushrooms.description: Procedurally generated mushrooms with wobbly soft body caps.

dna.default: flesh=soft, occurrence=scattered - identical to soft_mushroom, because this IS soft_mushroom: both tokens resolve to res://algorithms/softbodies/mushrooms/soft_mushrooms.tscn. Declared on both so the sibling is not left as an axis the sweep can never reach.
dna.was: the same three unnamed SoftBody3D numbers and the same unexamined randf_range scatter - see soft_mushroom for the full note.
dna.note: ONE SCENE, TWO REGISTRY NAMES. soft_mushroom (10 maps) and soft_mushrooms (Gallery_PhysicsSimulation) are the same object under two lookup names; the two measured AABBs differ only because the field is randomly generated per capture. Kept in sync by hand: if one declaration changes, change both.

dna.default: suspension=gantry - _rig_gantry() reruns the shipped setup_frame() arithmetic literally: same frame_width and frame_height expressions, same 0.5 thickness, same Color(0.5, 0.0, 0.1), same box sizes and positions, same CollisionShape3D per bar, same child order, same StaticBody3D named Frame. All 7 placements are bare cloth_straps tokens with no config, and GridInteractablesComponent only calls apply_grid_config when a token's config is non-empty, so none of them reaches that function at all. apply_grid_config additionally returns before touching anything when the value is unknown or unchanged, and never rebuilds the straps.
dna.was: one deep-red portal and only one - a top bar on two side posts with an open bottom, hard-coded in setup_frame(). A doorway, which is a claim: that the cloth is a threshold with a here and a there and that the point is to pass between them.
dna.note: the word and its five values are spring_system.suspension reused character for character - same question (what does a hanging body hang from, built to meet a rank that never moves), same four shapes plus none. NOT `support` (that axis is what a thing stands ON; nothing here stands on anything) and NOT `hang` (gallery_winner_showcase's axis is the arrangement of the hung objects; this one leaves the strap rank exactly where it was). strap_count is the @identity's critical_parameter and is deliberately NOT declared: with five suspension values the gallery's cap of 9 drops any second axis before it renders, so declaring it would add a ledger row no sweep ever measures. It stays a plain export the sweep can set before add_child, and apply_grid_config deliberately does not accept it: honouring a count change at runtime means respawning every SoftBody3D on a live placement.

cloth_straps.name: Cloth Straps
cloth_straps.description: Hanging soft body cloth straps that the player can walk through.

revolving_joy_ride.name: Revolving Joy Ride
revolving_joy_ride.description: A rotating ride with hanging soft bodies colliding with obstacles.

pendulum_slap.name: Pendulum Slap
pendulum_slap.description: A double pendulum that slaps soft bodies.
pendulum_slap.qfep_connection: A double pendulum — the textbook chaotic system — is armed with a heavy paddle and given exactly one opening shove; the soft body downstream absorbs whatever chaos delivers. The slap is fully computed and never the same twice: determinism without repeatability, arriving as a blow.

softbody_gallery_part1.name: SoftBody Gallery Part 1
softbody_gallery_part1.description: Part 1 of the soft body test gallery.
softbody_gallery_part1.qfep_connection: Twelve labeled stalls, the same pressurized flesh dropped on cube, sphere, capsule, and ramp in turn — a comparative anatomy of yielding. The name-tags track vertex zero through the physics server, because a soft body keeps no stable center to speak from.

softbody_gallery_part2.name: SoftBody Gallery Part 2
softbody_gallery_part2.description: Part 2 of the soft body test gallery.
softbody_gallery_part2.qfep_connection: A drop-test census: the same softness settings pressed onto sphere, box, capsule, and torus, each cell labelled and tracked as it falls and settles. Softness revealed as a negotiation between material parameters and the shape they inhabit.

softbody_gallery_part3.name: SoftBody Gallery Part 3
softbody_gallery_part3.description: Part 3 of the soft body test gallery.
softbody_gallery_part3.qfep_connection: The gallery's late wing is all engineered failure: negative pressure coefficients, timed deflate_rate leaks, stalls named Flat Tire, Crumple Zone, Slow Collapse. Caving-in staged as a parameter rather than an accident — a body's ruin as designable as its bounce.

rounded_softbody_test.name: Rounded SoftBody — Strain Energy
rounded_softbody_test.description: Deformable rounded cube with 3 modes: strain energy heatmap coloring by vertex displacement, collision-response force arrows with impact bursts, and volume preservation with real-time ratio chart. VR hand squeeze interaction pushes vertices. ImmediateMesh overlays for all visualizations.

dna.default: measure=strain - _mode_from_word("strain") returns Mode.STRAIN, which is exactly what `var _mode: int = Mode.STRAIN` already was, and the harness root forwards NOTHING at the default, so the 8 existing placements make one call fewer than before rather than one more. The MODE button still cycles STRAIN - COLLISION - VOLUME.
dna.was: Three modes reachable only by finding and pressing the MODE button in VR. No @export behind them, so the gate read NO EXPORT; and the scene root carried no script at all, so apply_grid_config on the root fell through and the research runner could resolve no .gd from the scene.

rounded_softbody_test.qfep_connection: Squeeze it and the strain field blooms red under your grip, E = ½k·d² kept per vertex — the body's ledger of every displacement from rest. In volume mode the far side bulges as you press, conservation arriving as a felt refusal.

rounded_softbody.name: Rounded SoftBody — Compression Bench
rounded_softbody.description: Deformable rounded cube seated in a milled well on a terminal-finish compression bench (cabinet grammar, horizontal dialect). Strain-energy heatmap, collision-force arrows, and volume-preservation readout. The canon member; rounded_softbody_test is the bare harness.

dna.default: measure=strain - the same @export on the same rounded_softbody.gd the harness token declares, resolving to Mode.STRAIN, which is what `var _mode: int = Mode.STRAIN` already was. Declared on both names because ONE SCRIPT SERVES BOTH: leaving it undeclared here left the axis promoted in code and unreachable by the sweep, which is the gate's own complaint. The 1 existing placement is untouched.
dna.was: The same three unreachable modes as rounded_softbody_test, behind a VR push_button and an apply_grid_config key with no export behind it.

rounded_softbody.qfep_connection: Squeeze it and the strain field blooms red under your grip, E = ½k·d² kept per vertex — the body's ledger of every displacement from rest. In volume mode the far side bulges as you press, conservation arriving as a felt refusal.

jelly_cube.name: Jelly Cube
jelly_cube.description: A soft, deformable cube that jiggles when touched. VR-enabled with physics parameter controls for stiffness, damping, and pressure.
jelly_cube.qfep_connection: Low stiffness = high Î» territory. Form becomes fluid, resists fixed categories.

dna.default: assay=none - the early return in _assay_dressing, which does not even create the Assay pivot, so the 0.3 m soft body, its plinth, its label and its rack stand on nothing exactly as they did in all 4 rooms. Every other rung builds under ONE Node3D appended AFTER _create_vr_controls, so no legacy child index moves and no branch below the match touches _soft_body, _material or a single physics value. All four placements (SoftBodies_Soft_Body_Deformation and its _p1/_p2/_p3 siblings) are the bare token `jelly_cube:0:0.5:1` with no #key:value, and GridInteractablesComponent only calls apply_grid_config when merged_config is non-empty, so none of them reaches the new code at all.
dna.was: DERIVED, not composed. The axis, its allow-list, the five builders and the guarded apply_grid_config were already in commons/artifacts/jelly_cube/jelly_cube.gd (committed d3b41fbab) and the registry had never been told, so check_dna_declarations listed jelly_cube under 'promoted in code, undeclared in the registry' and the sweep could not reach any of it. What this pass added is the declaration and nothing else - not one line of the artifact was touched, because the code was already right: apply_grid_config returns unless the word is in the allow-list AND differs from the word already standing AND is_node_ready(), and _read_dna_meta lets a token's word be built once in _ready instead of built and torn down a frame later.
dna.note: assay is the softbody bench family's word and its five values, character for character - grab_jelly_bench, mass_spring_bench, energy_landscape_bench, membrane_bench, rigidity_dial_bench, abject_bench, octopus_bench, becoming_bench and tentacle_grab_bench all ask what apparatus a specimen is surrounded by, and jelly_cube stands in the same softbodies sequence as every one of them. The kit is re-dimensioned by a single factor u = cube_size / 0.5 so the family's proportions, accents and captions survive at this artifact's smaller scale; `control` is the rung that argues hardest, because an empty wire cage at the size the cube had BEFORE anything happened to it turns a thing you are watching into a difference you could disagree with.
dna.still_note: THE JIGGLE IS NOT AN AXIS AND CANNOT BE, and this is why the apparatus carries the claim instead. Everything jelly_cube exposes - stiffness, damping, pressure, mass - is a STARTING CONDITION on a body that relaxes, so five cubes started five ways settle into the same shape and photograph as one object five times; cloth_straps hit exactly this and took `suspension` for the same reason. Every assay rung is standing geometry: a graduated column, a wire reference cage, a plotted board, a glass case. The chart's settling trace is CLOSED FORM (exp(-3.4f)cos(13f)) and not sampled from the running solver, because a plot that came out different every launch would be noise wearing the costume of a record.
dna.framing_note: unchecked against a capture in this pass. The subject is a 0.3 m cube on a 0.42 m plinth, and _create_vr_controls already hangs a rack panel at z = 0.36 tilted -30 degrees; `chart` adds a board behind at -0.31 and `control` a second plate 0.35 m to the right, so the union-of-variants camera is pulled well back from the jelly itself. If the axis measures faint, check subject % before believing it - the apparatus IS the axis here, so a frame dominated by apparatus is not the failure it would be elsewhere.
dna.sibling_note: jelly_variants.gd carries the same axis and is likewise undeclared in the registry; it was outside this pass's three tokens and is left for the batch that owns it.

softbodytest.name: softbodytest
softbodytest.qfep_connection: A controlled trial for flesh: the same soft sphere dropped on a cube, a sphere, a capsule, a ramp, then against its own settings — high pressure, jelly, slow deflation. The floating labels must chase vertex 0 through PhysicsServer3D because a deforming body has no stable origin; where it 'is' becomes a convention renewed every frame.

dna.default: flesh=soft, occurrence=scattered - soft returns the shipped linear_stiffness 0.2 / damping 0.05 / pressure 0.5 value for value, and scattered draws the SAME two randf_range calls in the same order off the same global generator (rng_seed defaults to 0, which leaves the seeded generator null). The 10 map placements grow the garden they always grew.
dna.was: three unnamed SoftBody3D numbers and a for-loop over randf_range. The @identity truth says 'a mushroom cap does not decide its shape - the pin constraint, gravity and whatever bumps into it negotiate the form', and the tissue doing the negotiating was hard-coded at one setting. The scatter was not a decision at all: it is what a loop does when nobody asks, yet it is a claim about fungal ecology - that fruiting bodies come up independently - and it is not the only one fungi make.
dna.note: flesh is a MATERIAL property, not a time-domain one, but the sweep photographs at 1.1 s and a SoftBody3D at stiffness 0.05 with damping 0.05 is still moving then. The four values will differ in the frame - turgid holds a ball while slack has already collapsed - but the picture is a snapshot of a negotiation in progress, not four rest states. Deterministic under the fixture's seed, so the comparison is fair; it is simply earlier than rest. occurrence is a positional axis and is at rest immediately.
dna.fixture_note: rng_seed and spawn_span are bench knobs added for this, both defaulting to 0 = 'as shipped'. Without a seed, fifteen unseeded randf_range draws per variant make five variants five different gardens and the sweep measures noise - the documented failure for any generative artifact. Without spawn_span the field is the measured 19.45 x 20.07 m, which puts a 2 m cap at roughly 26 px in a 760 px frame: the caps become specks and an axis about cap SHAPE cannot be read at all.
dna.open: spatial_needs.footprint_cells is 9 while measured_footprint_cells is 420 - the registry books this 20 m field as a 3x3 prop. Not touched here; recorded so it is not lost.

frozen_glass_vessel.name: Frozen Glass Vessel
frozen_glass_vessel.description: Walkable glass vessel whose shape emerged from physics, not design. Sphere + top-pin ring + pre-inflation pulse + gravity + N settle steps = a drooping amphora, long bottle, wide bowl, or slumped vase depending on force balance. The clock is part of the genome — duration as design parameter. Walkable twin of gl01_classic_bulb from the soft-body gallery.

spring_node_toy.name: Spring Node Toy (the atom of a soft body)
spring_node_toy.description: A held two-mass-one-spring: the spring pulls toward its rest length. A soft body is just this, many times over.

mass_spring_bench.name: Mass-Spring Bench (a shape nobody specified)
mass_spring_bench.description: A grid of masses and springs settling on a bench - each spring pulling to rest length, the whole finding a shape nobody specified.

verlet_workbench.name: Verlet Workbench (constraints that hold themselves)
verlet_workbench.description: A cloth relaxing under a Verlet integrator with a constraint-pass dial - integrate position from position, and the constraints hold without ever being solved.

pressure_dome_room.name: Pressure Dome Room (pushing out, pulling back)
pressure_dome_room.description: A room-scale pressurised soft dome you stand under: internal pressure pushing out against strain energy pulling back - a balance held, not a skeleton imposed.

elasticity_press.name: Elasticity Press (strain energy, stored and returned)
elasticity_press.description: A press squeezing a soft block, a strain-energy readout climbing as it compresses and springing back on release.

descent_marble_toy.name: Descent Marble Toy (finding a shape is rolling downhill)
descent_marble_toy.description: A held marble-in-a-bowl rolling down to its minimum: finding a shape is rolling downhill on an energy landscape.

energy_landscape_bench.name: Energy Landscape Bench (height is energy)
energy_landscape_bench.description: A soft body settling on a wavy energy-landscape surface where height is energy, descending into the nearest basin.

max_q_basin_room.name: Max-Q Basin Room (the liveliest minimum)
max_q_basin_room.description: A room with a deep narrow DEAD well (rigid, one shape) and a shallow wide ALIVE well (soft, a shape it keeps re-finding). Max Q is the liveliest minimum, not the deepest.

gradient_descent_optimizer.name: Gradient Descent Optimizer (the bridge to learning)
gradient_descent_optimizer.description: A soft body descending an energy landscape toward max Q with a step/energy readout - the same motion as training a model. Soft bodies are gradient descent you can poke.

jelly_room.name: Jelly Room (push it, it forgets)
jelly_room.description: A room of wobbling jelly pillars you walk among: push it and it pushes back, then forgets - elastic deformation, the body that returns to itself.

cloth_loom.name: Cloth Loom (all surface, no inside)
cloth_loom.description: A loom draping a flag or sail under gravity and breeze - cloth is the simplest soft body, all surface and no inside, learning to fold from its own weight.

bounce_egg_toy.name: Bounce Egg Toy (store it, give it back)
bounce_egg_toy.description: A held squishy egg that bounces and squashes: store the impact in the springs and give it back.

bounce_arena_room.name: Bounce Arena Room (bounce instead of break)
bounce_arena_room.description: A room-scale bounce arena of trampolines and soft pillars - the joy of a body that bounces instead of breaking.

viscous_bench.name: Viscous Bench (where soft becomes fluid)
viscous_bench.description: A bench of viscous blobs oozing, merging, slumping - turn down the stiffness and the soft body starts to flow.

lava_lamp_tool.name: Lava Lamp Tool (viscosity as a tool)
lava_lamp_tool.description: A lava-lamp device: viscous blobs rising and falling in a glass column on a heat loop - viscosity put to use.

membrane_toy.name: Membrane Toy (an inside, and a way across)
membrane_toy.description: A held lipid-bilayer patch that lets a particle cross: the boundary that makes an inside while letting the world across.

membrane_bench.name: Membrane Bench (the Markov blanket made flesh)
membrane_bench.description: A selectively-permeable membrane on a bench: small particles cross, big ones bounce - the Markov blanket made flesh, the edge an organism holds by exchanging.

membrane_filter.name: Membrane Filter (the boundary as a tool)
membrane_filter.description: A membrane as a dialysis filter: mixed particles in, only some pass, sorted out the other side.

breathing_toy.name: Breathing Toy (a boundary that holds by moving)
breathing_toy.description: A held breathing sac that swells and shrinks - a boundary that holds its shape only by moving.

breathing_hall_room.name: Breathing Hall Room (it could burst)
breathing_hall_room.description: A room whose soft walls and columns breathe - bulging in and out around you. It breathes, it bulges, it could burst.

pressure_valve_tool.name: Pressure Valve Tool (the abject, regulated)
pressure_valve_tool.description: A valve regulating a breathing soft body: a gauge, the body swelling until released - the abject boundary as a regulated tool.

miura_press.name: Miura Press (a solid packed into a line)
miura_press.description: A press folding a flat sheet into a Miura-ori packed solid and back - the crease pattern that packs a map, a solar array, a wing into a line.

folding_menagerie_room.name: Folding Menagerie Room (walks by folding)
folding_menagerie_room.description: A room of folding creatures unfolding and re-folding, each moving by changing its shape - structure that walks by folding, not by pushing against bone.

octopus_bench.name: Octopus Bench (no bone, all middle)
octopus_bench.description: An octopus arm curling and coiling on a bench, suckers along its length - distributed soft cognition, no bone.

octopus_room.name: Octopus Room (the queer body)
octopus_room.description: A room-scale octopus: a soft mantle, eight curling arms, colour-shifting skin. No skeleton, not a puddle - the queer body par excellence.

rigidity_toy.name: Rigidity Toy (the alive middle)
rigidity_toy.description: Crystal, soft blob, puddle side by side - only the middle breathes. Rigid is dead, fluid is dead; soft is the only state that holds a form and still flows.

rigidity_dial_bench.name: Rigidity Dial Bench (sweep the stiffness)
rigidity_dial_bench.description: A row of bodies swept along a stiffness dial - crystal (frozen) through soft (alive) to puddle (slumped). The pointer rides to the live middle.

lambda_edge_room.name: Lambda-Edge Room (made flesh)
lambda_edge_room.description: A rigid crystalline wall on one side, a fluid pool on the other, and the soft alive forms breathing in the band between. You stand in the lambda_edge made flesh.

aliveness_meter.name: Aliveness Meter (peaks in the middle)
aliveness_meter.description: A meter reading how alive a body is by where it sits on the rigid-fluid axis - the needle peaks in the soft middle and drops to dead at both ends.

abject_toy.name: Abject Toy (won't stay inside its line)
abject_toy.description: A held abject blob that troubles its own boundary - a membrane that bulges and weeps a droplet, never quite staying bounded.

abject_bench.name: Abject Bench (softness as a feeling)
abject_bench.description: A soft body that leaks across its boundary - drips, seeps, reaches past its edge, pulls back. Abjection as a generative force; softness as a feeling.

abject_room.name: Abject Room (inside and out)
abject_room.description: A room of the abject: membranes leaking, boundaries troubled, soft forms reaching past their edges - the edge that troubles the line between inside and out.

becoming_toy.name: Becoming Toy (form emerges)
becoming_toy.description: A held scatter of particles drifting from noise into a coherent shape and back - form is not imposed, it emerges.

becoming_bench.name: Becoming Bench (entropy becoming morphology)
becoming_bench.description: A field of particles settling from disorder into an organized form - entropy becoming morphology.

self_shaping_forge.name: Self-Shaping Forge (the thesis made flesh)
self_shaping_forge.description: A forge where raw matter descends toward max Q, its liveliest form, and emerges - the project's thesis made flesh: gradient descent toward the shape that persists by moving.

grab_jelly_toy.name: Grab Jelly Toy (take it in your hand)
grab_jelly_toy.description: A held native SoftBody3D jelly cube with two grabbable nubs - take hold of a corner and it stretches, let go and it wobbles back.

grab_jelly_bench.name: Grab Jelly Bench (a soft body you can take hold of)
grab_jelly_bench.description: A real SoftBody3D jelly on a bench, pinned to four grabbable corner nubs - grab a corner and the jelly stretches like taffy, poke it and it dents.

stretch_blob_room.name: Stretch Blob Room (take hold and it follows)
stretch_blob_room.description: A room-scale soft blob hung from grabbable handles on a frame - grab a handle and the whole blob sags and stretches toward your hand.

taffy_pull.name: Taffy Pull (it stretches between your hands)
taffy_pull.description: A soft rod pinned between two grabbable handles - pull them apart and the taffy necks and stretches thin, with a live span readout.

poke_dough_toy.name: Poke Dough Toy (leave a dent)
poke_dough_toy.description: A held soft dough ball - press a finger in and it dents, slowly recovering. The player layer is in its collision mask, so a hand really pushes it.

pressure_balloon.name: Pressure Balloon (it pushes back)
pressure_balloon.description: An over-pressurised native SoftBody3D balloon on a knot - poke it and it dents, then bobs back taut. Pressure pushing out against your push in.

poke_pillar_room.name: Poke Pillar Room (they give and return)
poke_pillar_room.description: A room of tall soft pillars pinned at base and top - push through and they bend around you and spring back.

squish_press.name: Squish Press (force in, dent out)
squish_press.description: A press whose plate descends onto a soft block by real collision, denting it, with a force/dent readout - strain made visible.

bounce_blob_toy.name: Bounce Blob Toy (bounces, not breaks)
bounce_blob_toy.description: A held squishy ball resting in a cupped saucer - it sits, squishes, and bounces in place instead of breaking.

bounce_membrane.name: Bounce Membrane (store it, give it back)
bounce_membrane.description: A native cloth trampoline pinned at its corners with a heavier soft ball dimpling the sheet - store the impact in the springs and give it back.

jelly_ball_pit_room.name: Jelly Ball Pit Room (the pile gives)
jelly_ball_pit_room.description: A pit of self-colliding soft balls settling into a squishy pile you can wade through - native SoftBody3D, contained in a tray.

soft_catapult.name: Soft Catapult (a soft body stores the throw)
soft_catapult.description: A sling whose soft membrane pocket holds a ball, pinned along its back edge to a frame - the soft body stores the throw, with a load readout.

blob_pet_toy.name: Blob Pet Toy (grab its scruff, it dangles)
blob_pet_toy.description: A held soft creature with googly eyes and a grabbable scruff-nub - pick it up by the scruff and it dangles and wobbles.

tentacle_grab_bench.name: Tentacle Grab Bench (no bone, it follows)
tentacle_grab_bench.description: A boneless soft tentacle rising from a bench, base-pinned, with a grabbable tip - grab the tip and the whole arm follows and trails.

curtain_membrane_room.name: Curtain Membrane Room (push through, it parts)
curtain_membrane_room.description: A hanging native soft membrane pinned along its top bar - walk through and it parts and drapes around you, then falls back.

soft_handshake.name: Soft Handshake (it squeezes back)
soft_handshake.description: A greeting device: a soft paw on a post with a grabbable handle - shake hands with a soft body and it gives and squeezes back, with a squeeze readout.
